selection: Each component threshold selected on its earlier inner only with existing grid and higher-threshold tie. Complete O OR B policy selected on inner pooled F1 with listed tie order; only selected altered component refitted for outer. No outer-based recipe selection.
feature_postprocess: Unchanged champion active train-only year-depth and 168h cap 80 features, O global class weights, B event-day weights, inner threshold grid and decoder; no cell router, bracket, depth fallback, hard rule or row exclusion added.
primary: All Q2/Q3/Q4 pooled F1 on exactly 421032 outer rows; new retrospective tuning contract, not replacement or re-scoring of previous studies.
secondary: paired calendar-day bootstrap CI90 and probability of improvement
decision: Retain mean-improving selected policy; quarter declines, uncertainty and support gaps are risk columns, not automatic 0.8 gates. No automatic full fit or official inference.
not_run: B_slow excluded before fit for actual-model budget. Prior two-sided single-B same-rate 1400 curve is not this chronological O1/B3 learning-rate/complexity comparison.
parameter_provenance: Baseline exact legitimate training recipe. Alternatives are pre-fit bounded complexity/regularization and half-rate/double-round choices from prior train-only curve review, not derived from Public scores.
